title: Pay with a gift card at checkout
summary: Shoppers can enter a gift card code at checkout and use its balance towards the order.
acceptanceCriteria: A shopper can check a gift card's balance at checkout
The balance used can't be more than the order total
The card's balance goes down by the amount used, once, even if the order is placed twice at the same time
An unknown code shows a clear message

title: Order history for shoppers
acceptanceCriteria: A signed-in shopper sees their last 20 orders, newest first
Each order links to its detail page

title: Staff refunds from the admin app
acceptanceCriteria: Only staff can issue a refund
A refund can't be more than what was paid
The refund is sent to Stripe and the order is marked refunded
